title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion — Episode5 What You Can, With All You Have

meta.Episode: Episode5 — What You Can, With All You Have
meta.Event Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Line: Wedding Dress Fitting Area

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow! Look at all the wedding dresses...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Check out that ball gown!
It looks so fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No sleeves either! It's simple and really pretty! Oh, this mini skirt's also super cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can seriously choose from any of these dresses?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Pick whichever you like!
The staff here will answer any questions you have☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool! Then, where to start...
Maybe something standard, like an A-line...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, those are over that way!
I'll show you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those two certainly seem to be enjoying themselves. Which would you like to try on, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
I don't even know where to begin, so I'm okay with just seeing what's here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But wouldn't you like to try one on since we're here? It might be a good change of pace to put on something that you don't normally wear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why don't we try picking something out together? If you tell me your preferences, we may be able to find one you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Let's find one together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was initially under the impression that wedding dresses all had to be white. But the dress exhibit showed me how they come in a variety of colors, and I see the same thing here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: White is the old standard, but there's actually nothing wrong with choosing another color. What do you like, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, I'm not set on any particular one, but something simple and subdued might be nice if I'm going to be wearing it. I'd feel pretty embarrassed if I ended up standing out by wearing something too vivid...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, one of these may work...
This one has a bit of light gray mixed in.
Yes, I think this would look really good on you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Or... Oh, how about this one?
The lace pattern on it is so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, I think I'll try this one.
Thank you for helping me choose, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find something you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. Oh, but... Ms. Mochizuki, you haven't picked a dress yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't mind me. It shouldn't take me too long to pick one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you apologizing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like I've been giving you things to worry about this entire day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only did you go out of your way to invite me to this event, you just helped me pick out a dress to wear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even when we were going around the booth area, you noticed that I was tired and suggested that we go somewhere with less people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I must've seemed too overbearing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, please, don't say that.
If anything, I'm glad you're so worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's just... I feel like I'm making you work even though you're technically off right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know this isn't normal.
So, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I...
I like doing this is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, please don't mind me.
As long as you have fun today, I'll be happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Then, I will...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I just wanted Ms. Yoisaki to enjoy herself, but that ended up having the opposite effect...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is so much more difficult than I realized...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey!
Have you two picked out your dresses yet?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, Kanade, is that what you're gonna wear?! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ms. Mochizuki helped me choose it.
Otori, Mizuki, have you already picked yours out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ I just found the one I wanna wear!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm still kinda torn...
Can I ask you all for your opinions?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure. Oh, but... Ms. Mochizuki still needs a dress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Then, Honami, you should probably go find one for yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll go with her!
Kanade, you help Mizuki pick a dress☆

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, but I don't know if my opinion will help...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry! Just say whatever comes to mind for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami, they have lots and lots of pretty dresses here, so I'll try to show you as many of them as I can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Honami! Honami!
How about this one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! What a pretty pink, like the color of cherry blossoms... It's so lovely!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it! I thought it'd look really great on you! Also, just gimme a second to bring over some of the dresses I saw in that other section!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Honami?
You're all bunched up like a scrunchie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: L-Like a scrunchie...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I mean... You look like you're thinking a whole lot and your heart's being squeezed really tight!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At least, that's the expression you had on your face just now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you?
If so, you can tell me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, you just want Kanade to have fun today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that was the plan.
But it sort of ended up having the opposite effect.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize it would be this difficult...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
When I think “fun”, I think “shows”☆
So, we should put one on together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Us? Putting a show...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh! Just leave it to me!
I've got a great idea♪
Ten or so minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa! Check it out, everyone!
This is the dress I chose!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, so many frills...!
It's adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right? It's a pretty simple design outside of the frills, but that means it shouldn't take too much time or effort to put on. I figure I can try on a bunch of different dresses if they're like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I was really torn between pastel pink and magenta... Luckily, Kanade told me what she thought and I was able to decide on the pastel one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's going to look really good on you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
Do you already know what you're gonna wear, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, Emu helped me with that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great.
Then, let's head to the fitting rooms!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki!
Before we do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you know that you can do something really fun here along with trying on wedding dresses...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Something fun...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! After you pick out a dress, guess what...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can have your own mock wedding!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
A mock wedding...?
Yeah, that does sound like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Doesn't it?
You can have your pictures taken and even have a flower shower like a real wedding!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And there's more!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It doesn't have to be just any old wedding...
It can also be a show that you take part in!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, with the two participants as the main characters!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My brothers asked me if there was some way to make things more enjoyable for the guests...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I had a brainstorming session with Tsukasa, Nene, and Rui, and we came up with...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “A Beleaguered Bride: A Special Wedding Presentation”!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? A beleaguered bride...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If it's something Rui and Tsukasa came up with, it's probably gonna be a bit nuts...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha. True...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But being in a show sounds difficult. Are you sure it's okay for complete amateurs to participate...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry! Anyone is free to join in because it's such a simple story! You don't even have to read a script! Just listen to what the staff say and do what you'd do normally!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shows are really fun to watch, but they're just as fun to be a part of! I spent a lot of time with Tsukasa and the others thinking about how to make this fun for all the guests!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, should we give it a shot? I mean, it does sound pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, we shouldn't have much trouble participating in this show...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I hardly ever do anything like this, so I'm a little worried as to how I'll do...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (At the same time, if this is a chance for Ms. Yoisaki to have more fun...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'd like to give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes! I think it'll be fun!
So... Ms. Yoisaki, would you like to be in it as well?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I've never been in a show like this before...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I think we're all in the same boat there.
Why not take this opportunity to be in one with her, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really wanna see you perform in it while wearing that dress you picked out♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! But I won't force you to do anything you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, this kind of chance doesn't come by that often, so I kinda want you to have as much fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you say, Ms. Yoisaki?
Would you like to join me...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You will?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go let the staff know☆
Honami, Kanade, you two get changed!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait to see your guys' show!
And you wearing your dresses!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Kanade, Honami, break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to do my absolute best in order to make sure Ms. Yoisaki enjoys herself...!)
